summary: GPTour acceptance E2E (frontend-only, real Supabase roberto.beretta) PASSED. Verified: (1) input cleared immediately after tap and after response; (2) pending-hint shown with 6 follow-up count; (3) auto-scroll to follow-ups section (scrollTop 473 -> 1189); (4) gptour-keep-all and gptour-exclude-all present; (5) after exclude-all the follow-ups card disappears and a 13-stop plan appears (gptour-plan-metrics='13 tappe · 53.4 km') with gptour-map visible by default and gptour-toggle-map labeled 'Nascondi mappa'; (6) NO 'Nessun candidato rispetta i criteri' error; (7) criteria chips include area text 'tra Liscate e Paullo' and all 13 stops are in province MI (Liscate, Paullo, Melegnano, Mediglia, Pantigliate, Segrate - limitrofi MI); (8) 'Nuovo giro' resets plan, follow-ups and conversation; (9) /ai-tour regression loads normally. No gptour-warning-* or gptour-plan-warning-* produced. Constraints respected: no gptour-save, no gptour-reschedule-confirm, no 'Sposta nel CRM'.
action_items: Optional (not blocking): the criteria chip row surfaces only the area text ('tra Liscate e Paullo') and intent tags ('Da acquisire', 'Mai visitata'); no explicit province 'MI' chip is shown because the AI engine encoded the territory as free-form area rather than intent.requestedArea.provincia. Province is still correctly enforced server-side (all 13 stops are in MI). Consider surfacing the derived province code as an extra chip for transparency if the UX wants it visible.

Observed many deprecated-style console warnings from RN Web ('shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'). Not blocking GPTour, but worth cleaning up globally.

sendAndReveal wrapper sets scrollAfterSend before calling g.send - the TextInput value is cleared by useGptour.send before the API round-trip, confirmed empirically (empty immediately after tap and after response).
GptPlan default map visibility and 'Nascondi mappa' toggle label observed as expected; gptour-plan-metrics presents '13 tappe · 53.4 km' with no gptour-error.
Area parity: with the request 'tra Liscate e Paullo' (comune/zona soft, provincia rigid) the engine returned a plan with 13 MI stops and no 'Nessun candidato rispetta i criteri', confirming the fix.
seed_data_creation: None. Flow stayed read-only: no gptour-save, no reschedule-confirm, no 'Sposta nel CRM'. Only local state actions used (exclude-all, Nuovo giro, navigation).
